name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: 6sense needs someone who can sell complex, high-value advertising opportunities and hold their own with senior stakeholders. At Level Agency, I personally sold and closed 2 programmatic advertising accounts at roughly $30,000 in monthly recurring revenue each, about $360,000 in annual contract value per client, owning the relationship and strategy while a specialist team executed the buys.

That deal-closing discipline runs through my whole career. At Accelo, I ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank through a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled, consistently performing above commission floor into accelerator tiers. At Wix, I onboarded and launched 25+ clients a month at 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets. Across Accelo, Wix, and Level Agency, I built relationships with the executives who sign off on the deal, the same credibility this role needs with CMOs and senior marketing leaders.

My account base to date has been mid-market rather than Fortune 500, and I have sold programmatic rather than executed it hands-on in a DSP, but I know what it takes to close a six-figure annual contract and keep the relationship afterward. I would welcome the chance to talk through how that applies to 6sense's enterprise motion.
